subject.title: [Bug]: Discord elevated allowFrom fallback from channels.discord.allowFrom does not work on 2026.3.22

question: Should OpenClaw restore the released Discord `channels.discord.allowFrom` fallback for elevated exec, or make explicit `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord` the supported security contract going forward?
rationale: The latest release documented the fallback, current source lacks it, and current main docs now require explicit elevated allowlists; automation should not choose this authorization boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Restore narrow Discord fallback
options.body: Implement the fallback in the Discord-owned elevated adapter path and share it with diagnostics while preserving explicit-empty and per-agent restrictions.

options.title: Keep explicit elevated allowlists
options.body: Treat current docs as the intended security contract, then close this issue only after explaining the release-doc mismatch and supported migration path.

options.title: Adopt the linked fix PR after rework
options.body: Have a maintainer take over or request changes on the open fork PR to resolve conflicts, plugin-boundary concerns, and proof gaps.

recommendation.title: Restore narrow Discord fallback
recommendation.body: Implement the fallback in the Discord-owned elevated adapter path and share it with diagnostics while preserving explicit-empty and per-agent restrictions.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is the strongest history-backed owner for both the elevated authorization boundary and the docs correction that changed the documented fallback contract.
